title.tl: Trahediang Tinula ni Schiller sa Wikang Aleman

description:
In 1886, while in Leipzig, Germany, Rizal translated Friedrich Schiller’s drama Wilhelm Tell into Tagalog, titling it Guillermo Tell and sent a copy to his brother Paciano in Calamba, Laguna

In a letter to Blumentritt in October 1886, as he hopes for a better political condition he intends to say one day to posterity what Schiller did to the Swiss:

“We have conquered this land with the diligence of our hand; the old forest, which formerly was the abode of wild bears, we have changed into the habitation of men; we have killed the spawn of the dragon.”

## References

Domingo, Benjamin. Rizal in Germany. Foreign Service Institute, 1983.
